judge.rationale: The candidate makes the exact same production code fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` as the reference, moving `beforeSession` inside the `try` block, and satisfies all acceptance criteria including CHANGELOG and spec updates. However, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate unnecessarily regressed the spec status from `Shipped` to `In Progress`, and mistakenly moved the out-of-scope `instanceof Error` gate bullet out of the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section (leaving only one bullet under the heading 'These two properties...'). Additionally, the candidate added a redundant `chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts` file and a `.lore/dod.md` artifact alongside the unit test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and did not assert the execution order between `onError` and `afterSession`.
